host.name: Cole Patterson
host.hostingNote: spare bedroom in Lower Greenville. any weekend I'm not at the lake.

ride.note: going up for family anyway so the car's going regardless. civic, 2 seats, fri 5pm from mueller (yes in traffic, sorry), back sunday night. I drive the speed limit and I'm not sorry about that either. $15 each or buy me a kolache in west.

event.title: Deep Ellum Vintage Market (winter edition)
event.location: Deep Ellum Art Co. + the lot behind it

evidence.author: Cole Patterson
evidence.caption: deep ellum on a sunday afternoon when it's quiet. the overpass pillars painted like trees, then actual trees and grass in the little park past them, brick buildings behind. nobody's out yet. truck's in the lot, spare bedroom in lower greenville's empty, come up

evidence.author: Harper Nguyen
evidence.caption: big tex standing over the cacti with his arms out like he's about to hug 100k people. cotton bowl behind him, texas flag, the whole fair. fletcher's corny dog is $10 now which is a crime but I paid it. go on a weekday, parking's $25 on weekends, ride the dart instead, $6 all day

trips.title: san antonio with gabe, abuela cooks
trips.pitch: gabe's southtown spare room is open and his abuela will feed you. cheap bus down, pearl at dusk like his reel.
reasons: gabe free + open to hosting, spare room in southtown
bus roundtrip ~$36, total ~$96 with his cheap spots
pearl fountains at dusk from his reel, free to walk
mission san josé arches free, lena's around too

host.name: Gabriel Flores
host.hostingNote: spare room at my place in Southtown. abuela lives downstairs and will cook.

evidence.author: Gabriel Flores
evidence.caption: pearl at dusk. the ground fountains lit up, trees wrapped in string lights, a kid and a dog losing their minds in the spray, the old brewery chimney behind it all. saturday ritual. free to walk, $12 tacos if you cave #sanantonio #thepearl

evidence.author: Gabriel Flores
evidence.caption: mission san josé with abuela on a cloudy sunday. the long wall of stone arches, two rows, green bushes in front, weathered like it's been there 300 years because it has. free. national park. she lit a candle and then made me drive her to h-e-b. spare room in southtown is open, she WILL cook for you

trips.title: houston with raj in montrose
trips.pitch: raj has the montrose guest room with a million towels and he's free. easy bus in, he'll show you night markets.
reasons: raj free + open to hosting in montrose
bus roundtrip ~$48, total ~$108 with his cheap spots
tj + layla + maddie all in town that weekend too

host.name: Raj Iyer
host.hostingNote: guest room in Montrose. always. I have a ridiculous number of towels.

evidence.author: Raj Iyer
evidence.caption: the banh mi on bellaire. $4.50. shredded pork, pickled carrots, cucumber sticks, a fistful of cilantro, on paper like it should be. this is the first stop on my official night market tour (the tour is me, driving you, for free). guest room in montrose has a ridiculous number of towels, come use them

evidence.author: Layla Haddad
evidence.caption: the saturn v lying down in its hangar is the whole museum for me. stages stretched out on black supports, the burnt capsule at the front, info signs on fake grass. it's like $30 to get in which is steep but the rocket alone is worth 20 of it. sundays I'm usually at the museum district instead, half those are free
